name: Septicemia - xiao_raphael_00
description: The septicemia_yyyy.parquet files are populated using CCS code 2 (Septicemia) to retrieve the corresponding ICD-9-CM and ICD-10-CM diagnosis codes, as defined in the github repo /conf/icd_codes/xiao_raphael_00.yml. The CCS mappings are based on the Agency for Healthcare Research and Quality (AHRQ) Clinical Classifications Software (CCS) crosswalks for ICD-9-CM and ICD-10-CM.

content.admission_date: Timestamp[us]: Admission date of the beneficiary
content.outcome_criteria: String: Defines the rule used to evaluate ICD codes for admissions.`all`considers all available diagnosis codes for the admission and `first_n`considers only a specified number of diagnosis codes (e.g., the first 5) when determining whether the admission meets the outcome criteria
